title: xingo-sparse: sparse linear algebra for optimization solvers
description:
Sparse linear algebra for optimization in pure Rust: generic CSC/CSR containers, a threshold-pivoting LU for simplex bases with Forrest-Tomlin updates and hypersparse solves, AMD and COLAMD orderings, scaling, and regularized, refined KKT solvers for interior-point methods. The linear algebra layer of the Xingó solver.
